news.contents: Baltimore Ravens running back Derrick Henry (head) cleared concussion protocol after an injury scare late in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Carolina Panthers. Henry fell backward and appeared to hit his head hard on a 15-yard touchdown run with 6:32 remaining in the fourth quarter, and he went to the medical tent. The veteran back led Baltimore's ground game with 13 carries for 94 yards and added four catches on five targets for an additional 17 yards in Sunday's narrow loss. Henry has 185 carries ...

news.analysis: After splitting work pretty evenly for much of the season, Hampton has taken over the Los Angeles backfield over the past two weeks. He has seen 36 of the 48 running back carries over the past two games as the Chargers have made it a point to get him going on offense. Hampton is shaping up as a low-end RB2 in fantasy for the rest of the season with the Patriots up next in Week 12.

news.contents: Los Angeles Chargers running back Omarion Hampton finally produced as the fantasy running back everyone had hoped he would be last week. news.analysis: Wilson's modest yardage total was good enough to lead the team in a game where the Jets only attempted 21 passes and threw for 176 yards. Wilson has been a bit boom/bust this season, but he remains a solid fantasy WR2, posting 53 catches for 672 yards and three touchdowns in 10 games. He will be a solid option in Week 12 vs. the Dolphins.
